title: Concept: Object element loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: An object element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The embedded document arrives over an unauthenticated channel, so a network attacker can substitute the content the customer sees inside the bank's page.
applicability: Deployments that render an object element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The embedded document arrives over an unauthenticated channel, so a network attacker can substitute the content the customer sees inside the bank's page.
